title: rosa × umbelliflora var. typica
intro: Rosa × umbelliflora var. typica, commonly known as the Himalayan rose, is a hybrid species of rose that is native to the Himalayan region. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of the Himalayan rose include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce pain and inflammation, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
